title: The hat and plus version of the Heegaard Floer contact invariant are not equivalent
summary: We advance Matkovič ideas, originally applied to complete the classification of tight structures on small Seifert fibred $L$-spaces, to show the existence of contact structures on Brieskorn spheres which are tight and zero-twisting. This uncovers a phenomenon that has never appeared in literature before: namely, that a contact structure $ξ$ on a 3-manifold can be such that $\widehat c(ξ)$ is non-vanishing, but $c^+(ξ)$ is zero.
